name: Guinness Beef Stew with Dumplings
author: The Wickham family

ingredients.item: 1.5 kg rump steak cut into large chunks

steps: Sauté bacon and beef in heavy frypan until coloured but not completely cooked.
Deglaze frypan with stock and pour over beef.
Add stout, tomato puree, thyme and brown sugar.
Sauté the garlic and onions until soft and lightly browned.
Gently cook celery, mushrooms and carrots for a few minutes and add to meat.
Place dumplings in round shapes on top and bake a further 30 minutes at 180C.
Sift dry ingredients, work in butter.
Mix together egg and milk and add to mixture.

culture.text: Dumplings are a broad class of dishes that consist of pieces of cooked dough, often wrapped around a filling. The dough can be based on bread, wheat or other flours, or potatoes, and it may be filled with meat, fish, tofu, cheese, vegetables, or a combination. Dumplings may be prepared using a variety of cooking methods and are found in many world cuisines.
